WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM player_award AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
), hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throws, award_count,
           CAST(award_count AS REAL) / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT award_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM hand_shares
)
SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing or blank throwing hand is grouped as stored; SQL groups NULL values together and keeps blank strings as a separate group.
